h: Daniel Bwala reportedly responds to the NDC's 2027 campaign council list
p: Presidential aide Daniel Bwala has criticised the NDC's newly released campaign council, which features Peter Obi, Rabiu Kwankwaso and Governor Dickson, describing it as filled with content creators. Reports also point to disagreement within the NDC over the council list.
more: The NDC named the council earlier on Sunday.
The APC flagged off its own presidential campaign over the weekend.
